nodes.description: List of cluster nodes to be fenced using kdump-triggered crash dumps. Each node must be reachable via IPMI or another supported out-of-band method.

name.description: Unique hostname or identifier for the fence target node.

ip.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the target node’s IPMI/BMC interface.

port.description: IPMI port (usually 623); leave empty to use the default.

login.description: Username for authenticating to the target node’s IPMI/BMC interface.

password.description: Password for the IPMI user. (Secure: store in a protected file or vault.)

ipmi_cipher_suite.description: Cipher suite ID for RMCP+ encryption (e.g., '3' for AES-CBC-128). Leave blank for default.

ipmi_use_legacy_keys.description: Whether to use legacy IPMI 1.5-style keys (required for older BMCs).

timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each fence operation before failure.

retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed fence operation.

delay.description: Delay (in seconds) before sending the next fence command in a retry sequence.

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output in logs.
